message.content:
I’m sorry I can’t give you the exact spot‑price of gold right now—my responses don’t include live market feeds.  

If you’re looking for the most recent U.S. gold prices, here’s what you can do:

| Source | How to get the latest price |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| **Financial news sites** – Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC, MarketWatch | Search “U.S. gold price” or look under their commodities section. They usually quote the last traded price per ounce. |
| **Gold exchange websites** – Kitco, GoldSilver.com, BullionVault | These sites publish daily spot rates updated frequently during trading hours. |
| **Brokerage platforms** – Fidelity, Charles Schwab, TD Ameritrade | If you have an account, check the commodity/FX tab for the current spot price. |
| **Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)** | FRED provides weekly averages if you only need a broader view rather than intraday ticks. |

The spot price reflects the global market but is quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce. For day‑to‑day fluctuations, checking one of the above sources will give you the most accurate figure.
